title: NVMe state-tier retention documents
description: Public contract for the mimo_halo.state_tier.retention CLI: the config (configs/state-retention.json), the observation (--input) and the decision (--output), each schema_version 1. The three document kinds are discriminated by their required keys. Byte caps are exact decimal (non-si) byte counts; timestamps are epoch seconds on the caller's explicit observation clock -- the tool never reads a wall clock. All retention windows are soft policy targets: nothing in this schema expresses a hard TTL eviction, and prefix entries never expire by age.

priority.description: 0 interactive, 1 high-priority local, 2 normal, 3 background. Lower numbers win admission and are evicted last.

epochSeconds.description: Finite epoch seconds on the explicit observation clock; must not be after observation.now.

bytes.description: Exact non-negative byte count; integers only, never a rounded or fractional estimate.

preferred_retention_seconds.description: Soft preferred retention window in seconds. Not a deadline: exceeding it never deletes bytes by itself (warm acts only as a class demotion trigger).

max_size_bytes.description: Soft tier quota in exact bytes. Warm overflow first demotes least-recently-accessed sessions to cold (metadata only: frees warm budget, never disk bytes) and the demoted bytes then consume the cold quota; only the cold quota or an explicit disk target deletes snapshots. Never resolved by age windows.

config.description: Retention policy config. Exact key set; unknown keys are refused so a typo cannot silently fall back to a default.

hot_idle_grace_seconds.description: Soft HOT idle grace. Without pressure nothing leaves HOT regardless of idle age; under pressure a HOT+WAITING session becomes a victim only once idle past this grace, unless a strictly higher-priority incoming request or a positive required_free_bytes under real uma_pressure overrides it.

prefix_cache.description: Independent immutable-prefix policy: no age expiry ever, LRU under its own quota or an explicit disk free-bytes target.

preferred_retention_seconds.description: Always null: conversation retention windows do not apply to immutable prefixes.

quick_reactivation_window_seconds.description: Observation horizon defining a quick reactivation after eviction (telemetry denominator convention only; this CLI emits no metrics).

needs_hot_slot.description: Boolean hot-slot admission demand; sized as exactly one incoming slot.

uma_pressure.description: UMA byte pressure; its target is required_free_bytes against the hot pool, and a positive target overrides hot idle grace for HOT+WAITING victims even with no incoming priority.

disk_pressure.description: Disk byte pressure; its target is required_free_bytes against prefix entries first, then NVMe snapshots.

required_free_bytes.description: Byte target for the flagged pressure resources. 0 means unsized: the rationale must say no byte target exists rather than invent freed memory.

session.description: Logical-session observation. Optional measured fields (restore cost, prefix reuse, etc.) may appear as additional properties; the initial policy validates the known keys and does not rank on unmeasured extras.

session_id.description: Opaque unique session identifier; echoed verbatim in decisions.

prefixEntry.description: Immutable prefix-cache observation. Additional measured reuse fields may appear as extra properties; entries are never selected by age.

compatible.description: Identity match against the required compatibility identity; incompatible entries are always selected for eviction.

observation.description: Decision input. All idleness derives from now; no wall-clock reads.

now.description: Explicit observation clock in epoch seconds; every idle duration is now minus last_accessed.

incoming_priority.description: Priority of the request awaiting admission, or null when no admission is pending.

action.description: keep retains current class/bytes; demote_to_cold changes warm/cold class metadata only; evict_snapshot removes a durable NVMe snapshot (cold-quota or disk LRU only, never age; warm overflow demotes first).

decision.description: Decision output. Every value is advisory: the module itself performs no runtime, scheduler or disk mutation.

hot_evictions.description: Sessions to yield from HOT, in selection order (slot victim first, then lowest-priority/longest-idle). Never RUNNING/SUSPENDING/RESTORING.

retention_actions.description: Exactly one action per observed session, input order preserved.

prefix_evictions.description: Prefix IDs to evict (incompatible first, then LRU quota/disk selections); never age-selected.

rationale.description: Human-readable decision accounting. Any sizing the observation cannot provide (unserved boolean demand, unmet byte targets) must appear here explicitly; freed numbers are always sums of observed state_bytes, never estimates.
